claims.assertion: Mari says astral planes cannot be comprehensively mapped; their levels are perspective-dependent, with no absolute boundaries between astral and material frequencies.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes biological bodies as frequency filters that confine perception to a shared material band; unseen ranges still exist.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says densities and astral levels form one continuum, and starships travel through it by matching their frequencies to destinations.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says astral thoughts manifest rapidly; during dreams or projection, visualizing protective powers can repel entities.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

coverage_gaps: Advice about finding frequency matches and avoiding dangerous situations
